entries.scope: Accepted ADR0046 D1 and ACCEPTANCE: finite existing runtime branch invariants inferred from schemas, preserve original producer values, retain dynamic checks. This registration exercises D1 only; no present deployment or remote write authority is inferred from historical D2.

CharacterActionNormV2Schema force/disposition branch parity only: constraint accepts forbid/allow_only, preference/commitment accepts prefer/avoid. Tested original valid constraint payload preserved and incompatible commitment rejected. No whole V2 authoring, compiler, active use or other schema certification.

V3 force/disposition union and nonempty selector dynamic check, plus CharacterCompilerCapabilityV1Schema registered literal consumer/version pairs. Tested original payload preserved, mismatch rejected, registered pair accepted and incremented version rejected. No proof registration list complete for all consumers, compiler implementations or public profile validity.

CharacterSkeletonPhaseOperationV1Schema existing allowed operation subset inferred as union. Tested remove_background original ID remains intact and remove_action_norm rejected statically/runtime. No complete migration operation/provenance or worker review behavior certification.

Entire one-case file: static V2/V3 incompatible force/disposition not assignable; V3 original constraint payload deep equality, incompatible forces/disposition and empty selectors rejected; valid V2 original payload deep equality and commitment mismatch rejected. Bounded local schema proof, no generated norm semantic accuracy.

Entire two-case file: invalid battle-mechanics version not statically assignable; every currently registered compiler pair roundtrips and version+1 rejects; remove_background operation exact payload preserved and remove_action_norm not allowed in skeleton phase statically/runtime. No claim all allowed operations individually covered or every required compiler registered.

limitations: Two whole local schema test files only
No upstream architectural change or live/deployment acceptance
Compiler test validates current registry pair consistency, not completeness of registry or compiler implementations
